text: A socket in TIME-WAIT appears in `ss` output. What does it indicate?
choices: A hung connection that should be killed
Normal TCP teardown behaviour, held so that delayed duplicate segments cannot corrupt a new connection on the same five-tuple
explanation: TIME_WAIT is a normal part of connection close and alarms people who have not met it. It exists so that a stale segment from the old connection cannot be mistaken for data on a new one reusing the same tuple.
